objective: Preregister 18 candidates for T-20260929-02 (dir:pre_holiday_effect_small_cap_tier): 12 primary PREHOL_{IWM,IJR,IWC,VB,SPY,QQQ}_H{1,2} candidates plus 6 PREHOL_{ticker}_RAND per-ticker frequency-matched placebos, for scripts/screen_batch.py --batch h20260929_02_pre_holiday_etf --iteration h20260929_02_pre_holiday_etf. No return, Sharpe or backtest number is computed in this dossier.

keep_rule.K1: net-10bp Sharpe (D freq, single version -- no offset sweep) >= 1.1882 anchor AND >= 0.6447 stress, positive 20bp CAGR both windows. 12 primary (PREHOL_*_H1/H2) candidates only.
keep_rule.K2: a 63-session trailing-inverse-vol monthly blend of the candidate with S3 beats a vol-matched k*S3+(1-k)*SHY control by >=0.05 Sharpe in BOTH windows. Primary candidates only.
keep_rule.watch_recent: anchor-window Sharpe >= 1.1882 but stress does not clear its bar -- forward-tracked only. Primary candidates only.
keep_rule.strong_keep: K2 edge >= 0.10 in both windows, or K1's Sharpe in both windows is >= S3's own (1.4853 anchor / 0.8059 stress).
keep_rule.placebo_internal_falsification: a primary candidate otherwise kept is demoted to not_kept if its own ticker's PREHOL_{ticker}_RAND placebo's judged anchor Sharpe >= its own anchor Sharpe.
keep_rule.pass_requires: K1 OR K2, primary candidates only, subject to placebo demotion.
keep_rule.small_cap_vs_large_cap_report_only: median judged Sharpe {IWM,IJR,IWC,VB} minus median judged Sharpe {SPY,QQQ}, both windows -- report only, not a gate.
keep_rule.multiple_comparisons: This iteration's own n_trials=18 (12 primary + 6 placebos). A manual 12-candidate-only DSR is additionally reported in report.md.
